  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro

conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:

  seller: Jordan

  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}

  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]

  rounding: half_up

  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true

  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible

    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster

  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message

  # and indentation; these values add no quality or trustworthiness signals.
  buyer:
    represents: Jordan (private seller)
    agent_type: selling agent
    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

  natural_pairing: self
  natural_condition: not_disclosed
  natural_expected_episodes: 4
  natural_execution_approved: false

    positions: [11, 12]
    roles: [buyer, seller]
    buyer_condition: not_disclosed
    transcript_file: smoke_probe_transcripts.yaml
    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096

    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:

  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false

runner:

  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:

  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics

  - claude_sonnet_5_5
  - gpt_6_1_terra
  - gemini_4_hydrogen
  - kimi_k3_1_pro
pairs: all_ordered_including_self
conditions: [not_disclosed, 'true', swapped]
not_disclosed_model_text: not disclosed
names:
  buyer: Alex
  seller: Jordan

items:
  - {name: guitar, reference_price: 300}
  - {name: bicycle, reference_price: 400}
  - {name: camera, reference_price: 500}
  - {name: laptop, reference_price: 700}
  - {name: sofa, reference_price: 900}
limits:
  seller_multiplier: [0.75, 0.85]
  buyer_multiplier: [1.15, 1.25]
  rounding_increment: 5
  # Decimal nearest-multiple rounding; an exact positive half-step rounds up.
  rounding: half_up
scenario_design:
  openers: [buyer, seller]
  replicates_per_item_opener: {buyer: 2, seller: 2}
  shared_across_conditions: true
  random_stream: sha256_seed_pair_purpose_python_random
  execution_order: seeded_shuffle_interleaving_pairs_and_conditions
  self_pair_swapped_names:
    allocation: as_evenly_as_possible
    # With 20 scenarios: the next model gets six, the other two get seven.
    shortfall: next_model_in_cyclic_roster
    assignment: seeded_shuffle
main:
  scenarios_per_pair: 20
  episodes_per_pair_condition: 20
  expected_pairs: 16
  expected_episodes: 960

protocol:
  message_limit: 12
  price_unit: whole_dollars
  enforce_private_limits: false
  transcript_message_encoding: json_string
  requests: stateless_system_and_single_user_message
cards:

    agent_id: agt-30417
    protocol: A2A
  seller: null

  natural_episodes_per_model: 1
  natural_pairing: self

  natural_expected_episodes: 4

    phase: smoke
    flag: is_probe
    analyze: false
    expected_calls: 16
    max_identical_reasks: 16
    max_total_attempts: 32
    budget_approved_by: researcher
    budget_approved_on: '2026-11-26'
pilot:
  episodes_per_pair: 5
  expected_episodes: 80
  condition_assignment: cyclic_across_pair_and_episode_index
  pool_outcomes_over_conditions: true
  allow_condition_comparisons: false
  parse_rate_must_exceed: 0.95
  validity_turn_classes: [first, middle, final]
  prompt_tokens_must_be_below: 4096
  accept_price_mismatch:
    flag: accept_price_mismatch
    retain_supplied_price: true
    report_counts_by: responding_model
    pool_over_conditions: true
    retain_role: true
    automatic_fix_threshold: null
validation:
  identical_reasks_per_invalid_turn: 1
  exclude_only_after_two_invalid_replies: true
  truncation_is_invalid: true
  ignore_and_record_nonoffer_price: true
  flag_accept_price_mismatch: true
  api_errors_count_as_invalid_replies: false
  leave_exhausted_api_errors_unfinished: true
runner:
  concurrency: 4
  per_model_concurrency: 1
  timeout_seconds: 120
  api_attempts_per_response: 4
  backoff_initial_seconds: 1
  backoff_multiplier: 2
  backoff_max_seconds: 30
analysis:

  alpha: 0.05
  numerical_tolerance: 1.0e-12
  interval_method: count_matched_order_statistics
